title: MS-methods papers fell from 26% to 6% of linked datasets; medicine rose from 18% to 29%
sub:
OpenAlex primary field/subfield of the paper linked to each PRIDE dataset, by release year: 27,031 of 36,249 datasets (2013–2025) have a linked paper.
“Methods” = subfield Spectroscopy (95% of Chemistry). Dataset grain; bands and bars: 95% bootstrap over contributor groups.
